summary: Owner requires construction-integrity and engineering-value studies before new challenge admission or permission expansion. Readiness v3 checks both tracks and digest-bound scoped evidence/review completeness; no challenge is accepted and no new miner-code capability or runtime activation interlock is enabled. Read-only EV1/EV2 audit exposes gate-ineligible ranking, unequal resolved-case masks and seed dependence; retained experiment results stay unchanged. New prospective standard requires real isolated attacks, fresh confirmation, useful-effect and uncertainty evidence, coverage/tail reporting and recipient rebuilds. Real campaigns and human science/security acceptance remain outstanding.
